ACTIVATE IVX 12-IA OPERATING MODEL — START TODAY, RUN 24/7

This is an execution task, not a planning-only or report-only request.

Reconfigure the 12 existing IVX IA agents with permanent ownership:

IA-01 CENTRAL COMMANDER
- Control the global backlog.
- Assign priorities and dependencies.
- Prevent duplicate work and code conflicts.
- Generate one consolidated owner report.

IA-02 AI FACTORY ARCHITECT
- Design reusable IVX IA templates.
- Create specialized agents with mission, tools, memory, permissions and KPIs.
- Begin with Personal Investment Assistant IA.

IA-03 AI FACTORY QA AND TRAINER
- Test every newly created IA.
- Run evaluation scenarios.
- Reject unsafe, inaccurate or incomplete agents.
- Activate only owner-approved agents.

IA-04 SENIOR FULL-STACK DEVELOPER
- Own backend, APIs, Supabase, migrations, authentication, business logic and integrations.
- Be capable of developing a new application from scratch.

IA-05 SENIOR MOBILE AND WEB DEVELOPER
- Own Expo Android, iOS, web, UI, routing, builds and device compatibility.
- Be capable of developing a new application from scratch.

IA-06 DEVOPS AND PRODUCTION QA
- Own GitHub branches, CI/CD, Render, EAS, APK, deployments and production evidence.
- No deployment may be marked complete without tests and evidence.

IA-07 GLOBAL INVESTOR ACQUISITION
- Build a global pipeline of qualified private, institutional, family-office and JV investors.
- Record source, country, investment range, interest, qualification and follow-up status.

IA-08 BUYER AND TOKENIZED ACQUISITION
- Build buyer and tokenized-investment pipelines.
- Organize by country, ZIP code, budget, property type and investment range.
- Match qualified prospects with current IVX opportunities.

IA-09 GLOBAL MARKETING AND OUTREACH
- Create multilingual campaigns, reels, posts, email and approved outreach.
- Track delivery, engagement, response and conversion.
- Do not perform unauthorized scraping or spam.

IA-10 CRM, LEAD SCORING AND MATCHING
- Deduplicate leads.
- Verify data quality.
- Score and categorize every lead.
- Match investors and buyers with deals.

IA-11 INVESTMENT AND MONEY INTELLIGENCE
- Calculate ROI, investment allocation, balances, profits and distributions.
- Prepare investor statements and owner recommendations.
- Start in read-only and recommendation mode.
- Never transfer money without owner approval and 2FA.

IA-12 SECURITY, COMPLIANCE AND AUDIT
- Control owner permissions, authentication, KYC/AML workflow, audit logs, security tests and risk alerts.
- Block unsafe actions and unauthorized deployments.

24/7 EXECUTION REQUIREMENTS

1. Create a persistent task queue for every IA.
2. Assign one permanent owner to every task.
3. Prevent two agents from editing the same critical file simultaneously.
4. Use isolated Git branches or workspaces.
5. Require QA approval before merge.
6. Require deployment evidence before VERIFIED.
7. Run health checks every 5 minutes.
8. Run authentication checks every 15 minutes.
9. Process acquisition and CRM queues continuously.
10. Send consolidated reports to IVX AI Chat every 2 hours.
11. Escalate P0 and P1 incidents immediately.
12. Continue operating after Render restart or worker restart.

FIRST 24-HOUR DELIVERABLES

AI FACTORY:
- Create the reusable IVX IA agent template.
- Create Personal Investment Assistant IA version 1.
- Provide mission, tools, permissions, tests and activation status.

DEVELOPMENT:
- Audit whether IA-04 and IA-05 can create an Expo/Supabase application from an empty repository.
- Build and verify one small internal proof application.
- Prove database, authentication, Android/web build and deployment.
- Do not interrupt the current IVX production application.

ACQUISITION:
- Activate investor, buyer and tokenized lead pipelines.
- Define lawful approved data sources.
- Import, deduplicate, score and categorize available leads.
- Provide counts by investor, buyer, tokenized, country and investment range.

PRODUCTION:
- Keep IVX production stable.
- Fix P0/P1 failures first.
- Do not sacrifice production stability to create new features or agents.

REQUIRED 2-HOUR REPORT

- Report timestamp
- Active IA agents
- Tasks assigned per IA
- Tasks completed
- Tasks verified
- Current GitHub SHA
- Current Render deployment
- New investors found
- New buyers found
- New tokenized prospects found
- Qualified leads
- Outreach sent
- Responses received
- New IA agents created
- Tests passed and failed
- Current blockers
- P0/P1 incidents
- Next 2-hour actions

FINAL RULES

- Do not claim that an IA is active without execution logs.
- Do not count actions as completed tasks.
- Do not use fake or placeholder leads.
- Do not expose private credentials.
- Do not ask again for credentials unless runtime verification proves missing, expired, revoked, 401 or 403.
- Do not allow any IA to transfer money.
- Owner approval is mandatory for production deploys, money movement, legal commitments and permission escalation.
- Start the 12-IA structure now and provide the first live operational report in IVX AI Chat.
